### Laureate Education Announces Date of Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


September 29, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/323177153/files/doc_news/Laureate-Education-Announces-Date-of-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Release-and-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


MIAMI, Sept. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Laureate Education, Inc. (NASDAQ: LAUR) plans to release results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on Thursday, October 29, 2026, before the stock market opens. Following the release, the Company will host a conference call with investors and analysts at 8:30 a.m. ET to discuss the third quarter results and the Company's business outlook.


Interested parties are invited to listen to the earnings conference call by[registering here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=A11AmhBZRRZPNib-Rore4FcP3Z4zbiijGPakWmoXFmiFg_VbVDLxAdhveTR6LaqjlXZs8guTnRg5nMvAM4F4G2kndMvVMFoMX3qQjYe5EB68O2fVcMLnVB0awJTlgMIQ3v8KhrvxAWYQM5tXxzGYKiGiDLu47rBgFff-b89IDNA=) to receive dial in information.


The webcast of the conference call, including replays, and a copy of the earnings release and the related slides will be made available through the Investor Relations section of the Company's website at[www.laureate.net](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=irWbltcPX8WA1IVAJbYOEaWUnH5JOfuszxS3pSnMFSsYgw1q9SauHheVL2schBH228OKljE93aCwiW5dQ_ajR1owIXZp0eCWkHLXM4HfGsg=) .


***About Laureate Education, Inc.***


Laureate Education, Inc. operates five higher education institutions across Mexico and Peru, enrolling approximately 500,000 students in high-quality undergraduate, graduate, and specialized degree programs through campus-based and online learning. Our universities have a deep commitment to academic quality and innovation, strive for market-leading employability outcomes, and work to make higher education more accessible. At Laureate, we know that when our students succeed, countries prosper, and societies benefit.
